premise: ¿Qué pasaría si todos fueran zombis menos tú?
hook: Te despiertas y eres el último humano.
angle: First-person survival journey hour by hour and day by day: waking up at home, the street full of zombies, getting supplies, the city going dark, where you would actually be safe. Each step explained with real science: how fast an infection spreads (epidemic models, R0), how long city water and power last without workers, why cold, water and height matter.
science_basis: Epidemiology (SIR models, R0), rabies and the Ophiocordyceps fungus as real 'zombifying' agents, how cities fail without maintenance (power grid, water pumping), human survival needs (water 3 days, food 3 weeks).
